title: Argentinian Vibrant Keto Bake
description: This vibrant argentinian bake is a flavorful keto dish made with tofu, perfect for a low-carb diet.
instructions: Cut the tofu into 2cm (1 inch) cubes.
Place the tofu in a baking dish and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the tofu is baking, mix the argentinian vibrant sauce, mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Remove the tofu from the oven and pour the cheese sauce over the top.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
